title: Teleport Circles: Portal
description: Retextures Teleportation Circles into a Portal style
body:
A resource pack for [Teleport Circles](https://modrinth.com/mod/teleport-circles) changing the default circles into a portal style. Both Active and dormant circles plus their particles have been retextured.

When first summoned, circles are dormant and nameless. Interact to activate and assign a random name. Interact with an active circle to see a list of other active circles. Select a desination from the list to instantly teleport. Rename a circle by clicking its name above the list in the gui.
